name: Melancholic Night
source:
A quiet night after work.

You stand in front of your house, or at least where it should be. Instead, a night bar stands there. Well the only thing left for you to do is to have a drink.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4561310/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
下班后的一个安静的夜晚。

你站在你的房子前面，或者至少是它应该在的地方。相反，那里有一家夜间酒吧。那么你唯一要做的就是喝一杯。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4561310/]Steam[/url]]
